body.description: a small farm windmill with fan blades on a tower, in the art style of a classic Gen-4 Pokemon Diamond Pearl Platinum overworld town building, clean simple flat cel-shaded pixel art with bold dark outlines, the roof viewed from a high top-down angle filling the upper part with a short front wall at the bottom, NO isometric side walls, bright limited palette, low detail simple shapes, post-apocalyptic solarpunk overgrown with vines, original design, top-down RPG map building, transparent background
